inner_validation: next sequence cyclically; six remaining sequences fit
adapter_inner_policy: same R3R2 architecture/loss/optimizer; strict six-sequence fit, early stopping on inner representation loss, max25 patience5; final weights remain six-sequence-only
historical_adapter_policy: SHA-verified seven-sequence refit is a heldout-only comparison; never used for inner controller selection
identity_calibration: mean/std of live causal fit-side Adapter scores, median positive base-score IQR; zero labels for calibration
authority_training: real branch-owned causal baseline rollouts; complete counterfactual solve/commit, current and next-frame offline GT supervision; wrong override cost3, non-target damage cost2; no GT inputs
lifecycle: dynamic NONE births, max_lost_gap90 for non-clicked tracks; clicked public ID remains eligible while lost
inner_selection: maximum official full-sequence HOTA subject to DetA>=baseline-0.005, then AssA, then fewer IDSW, then simpler policy; includes G0
outer_evaluation: all preregistered ablations and selected policy frozen before heldout batch TrackEval; no post-heldout modifications
VAL_policy: modal inner-selected configuration with deterministic simple-policy tie-break; final fit on eight dev sequences, three seeds; zero VAL tuning
